prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

paragraphs.text: Solutions Architect, the posting calls for end‑to‑end full‑stack delivery, which matches my work as a Systems Architect building production‑grade platforms from edge servers to AI‑agent pipelines. I have over four years engineering full‑stack platforms, business automation tools, and AI‑agent workflows.

I architected linkme‑intops, a React‑TypeScript CRM module on Cloudflare Workers that gives staff a dedicated interface for high‑value subscription accounts. I also built tycodes.app, a six‑stage agent pipeline that converts a business URL into a shoppable 3‑D demo in about a minute, using prompt‑engineered models and a verification stage to stop hallucinated claims. I later created tycodes.dev on edge infrastructure with Vite, React, TS, Tailwind, and a Hono Worker running Firecrawl and OpenAI for automated audits and pricing models. I designed zero‑maintenance serverless backends that use Google Sheets via OAuth, removing the need for dedicated servers. I designed integration blueprints and live demo environments that reliably onboard enterprise clients onto the core platform. At Fairman & Associates I led a modernization from legacy desktop software to cloud‑native web infrastructure, cutting manual data processing overhead by 68%.

I have not yet traveled beyond local client sites. To meet the up‑to‑15 % travel requirement I will work with the travel office, set a quarterly travel schedule, and use remote preparation to make each on‑site visit productive.

Thank you for your time. I would appreciate a conversation to discuss how my full‑stack and AI‑agent experience can support the Solutions Architect role. I am ready to apply my systems architecture background to design scalable, performance‑driven solutions for enterprise clients.
